risks.risk: Lens model and condition are unclear (could be a different lens than expected, or have fungus/scratches).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the lens front element and the lens label/engraving (model/part number) plus a photo of the lens mount and any markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Lumix G7 kit with an unspecified lens (worst-case: lens may be imperfect).

risks.risk: Camera functionality is not shown (could have shutter/mirrorless faults, overheating, or non-working buttons).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a quick photo/video recording playback.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Battery health/capacity is unknown (one battery may be weak or not holding charge).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of battery charge indicator after charging, or a video showing both batteries being used (battery icon/percentage changes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used batteries with unknown health (worst-case: reduced runtime).

risks.risk: Missing accessories not mentioned (e.g., body cap, charger cable, strap, USB cable, memory card).
risks.proof: Ask for a full laid-out accessories photo showing everything included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only what’s shown: camera + lens + 2 batteries + charger (worst-case: no other accessories).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the lens label/engraving (model/part number) and a clear shot of the front element.
Short video: power on → menu → autofocus on a subject → take a photo and play it back.
Show both batteries charging/charge level (or demonstrate switching batteries and recording).
Full accessories lay-flat photo of everything included (including cables/strap/memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos confirm a Lumix-branded mirrorless body and show 2 batteries plus a charger, but the exact lens model and—most importantly—whether the camera works properly are not verifiable from images alone. To price safely in Oyo, I need a quick functional proof and lens identification.
